goal.statement: Provide a bounded mechanical packet for reviewing a return, preserving exact evidence and leaving judgment and authority with Prime.

agreement.goal: Provide a bounded mechanical packet for reviewing a return, preserving exact evidence and leaving judgment and authority with Prime.
agreement.scope: Review this historical return and propose the smallest next action. Proposed packs are lab-only and must not be executed.
agreement.prime_discretion: Accept bounded technical work, identify corrections and propose a repair within the declared design.
agreement.director_required: Consequential design forks, new spending, real model trials, canonical migration and release of held work require Director judgment.

finish_criteria.text: Evidence-backed disposition and next-pack proposal or justified no-pack outcome, with scope and unknowns preserved.

recorded_decisions.text: Director approved a contextual Colab replay with Codex, Grok and Claude; no live work-book changes or build execution.
